evidence.observation: Growth-stage pressure starts at 3.04 Torr, matching the ramp plateau (~3.04-3.06).
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.329 Torr (~0.05 Torr per 120 s) and is still rising.
Ar flow is steady at ~100 sccm, so the flow input has not changed.
T is at the 750 °C setpoint and heater power is stable at ~46%; the thermal side looks normal.
The exhaust O2 sensor is not installed, so air ingress cannot be checked.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or a discriminating test (brief Ar flow step or isolate-and-rate-of-rise leak check), to tell a seal leak (air ingress) from an exhaust/pump-line restriction.
